references.text: Korah's rebellion is introduced; he is a Levite who leads the revolt against Moses and Aaron.
The genealogy of the tribe of Levi, showing Korah's lineage and his affiliation with the Levites.
The service of the Kohathites in the tabernacle is described—the group to which Korah belonged as a Levite.
Moses continues speaking to the Levites, pointing out that they have already been given a special service by God.
The tribe of Levi was chosen by the Lord to carry the ark of the covenant, stand before the Lord's presence, and serve Him.
A review of Korah's rebellion and its consequences, noting that Korah's sons did not die.
